hook.text: In 'John broke the window with a hammer,' each noun plays a different role in the event.

buildup.text: John is the agent (doer), the window is the patient (affected), the hammer is the instrument.

discovery.text: Thematic roles describe the semantic relationship between a verb and its arguments.

twist.text: The same role can appear in different syntactic positions: 'The window broke' makes patient the subject.

climax.text: Understanding thematic roles bridges the gap between syntax and semantics.

punchline.text: Who did what to whom—that's what roles track.
